description: This file declares interfaces, classes, enums, and component functions related to ADB (Android Debug Bridge) configuration within the Cuttlefish project. It includes licensing information, necessary includes, an enum for ADB modes, functions for converting between string and enum representations, and component function declarations for dependency injection.

classes.name: AdbConfig
classes.description: Abstract interface for ADB configuration, providing methods to get and set ADB modes and the status of running the connector.

classes.name: AdbConfigFragment
classes.description: A class inheriting from ConfigFragment, likely used as a configuration fragment in dependency injection.

classes.name: AdbConfigFlag
classes.description: A class inheriting from FlagFeature, likely representing a command-line flag or feature toggle related to ADB.

methods.name: AdbConfig::Modes
methods.description: Returns the set of ADB modes currently configured.

methods.name: AdbConfig::SetModes
methods.description: Sets the ADB modes using a set of AdbMode.

methods.name: AdbConfig::SetModes
methods.description: Sets the ADB modes using an rvalue set of AdbMode (move semantics).

methods.name: AdbConfig::RunConnector
methods.description: Indicates whether to run the ADB connector.

methods.name: AdbConfig::SetRunConnector
methods.description: Sets the status of running the ADB connector.

methods.name: StringToAdbMode
methods.description: Converts a string to the corresponding AdbMode enum value.

methods.name: AdbModeToString
methods.description: Converts an AdbMode enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: AdbConfigComponent
methods.description: Returns the dependency injection component providing an AdbConfig instance.

methods.name: AdbConfigFlagComponent
methods.description: Returns the DI component requiring AdbConfig and ConfigFlag, providing an AdbConfigFlag.

methods.name: AdbConfigFragmentComponent
methods.description: Returns the DI component requiring AdbConfig, providing an AdbConfigFragment.

methods.name: LaunchAdbComponent
methods.description: Returns the DI component requiring KernelLogPipeProvider, AdbConfig, and CuttlefishConfig components with specific instance parameters, used to launch ADB processes.
